title: Thailand Family Circuit
headline: Bangkok, Pattaya and a first look at the Thai islands.
description: A six-night family holiday: the capital, a coastal break in Pattaya, then Phuket beaches with room for children.
price_label: Quoted for your family and dates
price_guidance: Indicative family pricing depends on room type, child ages and whether Safari World or an island day is included. International flights sit outside the figure unless you ask us to ticket them.
overview: A classic India-to-Thailand family circuit. Two nights in Bangkok ease everyone in, Pattaya adds a coastal pause and a park or sanctuary day, then Phuket closes the week with beaches. Hotel rooms and transfers are planned for families, not only couples.
highlights: Bangkok temples and a river evening at an easy pace.
Two nights in Pattaya with a family-friendly day you choose.
Phuket beaches to close the week.
Private airport and hotel transfers in each city.
why: Three places, six nights — enough variety without a two-week itinerary.
Interconnecting or family rooms requested where hotels can offer them.
Daily load can be lightened for younger children.
inclusions: Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
Domestic flight to Phuket, once ticketed
exclusions: Thailand visa or exemption processing fees if they apply
Safari World, Alcazar or island-day tickets unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected family-friendly hotels in three cities
stay.room: Twin, double or interconnecting rooms as available

notes: Park tickets, shows and boat days are confirmed in writing. Sea and sanctuary days depend on operator hours. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: Suggested family order through Bangkok, Pattaya and Phuket. A city can be dropped for more beach time if you prefer.
